question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Escalate
solution:
The correct answer is "**Diminish**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: 
 
• **"Escalate" means to increase or intensify, so the antonym should mean to decrease or reduce.**(तीव्र करना)
 
 
• Example: We do not want to escalate the war.
 
 
 
• **"Diminish" means to make smaller or lessen in intensity, making it the correct antonym of escalate.**(घटाना)
 
 
• Example: The new law is expected to diminish the government's chances.
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "diminish" is the antonym of the word "escalate."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Corrupt means to cause to become dishonest or immoral, which is not an antonym of escalate.(भ्रष्ट)
 
• Intensify means to make stronger or more intense, which is a synonym of escalate.(तेज)
 
• Enlarge means to make bigger or expand, which is not an antonym of escalate.(बढ़ाना)
